component.name: Snow Shot
component.summary: Screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content

description.p: Snow Shot is a screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content. It offers region and fullscreen capture, annotation tools, pinned snapshots, OCR, and screen recording.
This Linux build targets KDE Plasma on native Wayland (with an X11 fallback). Screen capture and global hotkeys are delivered through xdg-desktop-portal where the platform supports them.
